Title: Completion detects non-flag argument as flag

We have encountered some odd behavior in the auto completion.
It appears that arguments with a dash as the second character are detected as
flags by mistake.

Minimal reproducer:

    package main

    import "github.com/spf13/cobra"

    func main() {
        root := &cobra.Command{Use: "root"}
        root.SetArgs([]string{"__complete", "1-ff00:0:1", ""})
        root.Execute()
    }

which results in:

    [Debug] [Error] Subcommand 'root' does not support flag '1'
    :0
    Completion ended with directive: ShellCompDirectiveDefault

The argument "1-ff00:0:1" (and similar values like "1-123") is incorrectly
classified as a flag during shell completion. It should be treated as a normal
positional argument. Long flags should only be detected when the argument
actually starts with "--".
